plugins.name: kai-dev
plugins.description: JIRA-driven development orchestrator — takes a ticket and drives it end-to-end: understanding, exploring, planning, building, reviewing, and creating PRs. Works in any repository.

plugins.name: kai
plugins.description: Mosaic Wellness internal-tooling co-pilot — wires Mixpanel, Firebase, New Relic, the Kai orchestrator, and admin-mcp (page configs, PDPs, widget pages, experiments, habit trackers) with brand-aware skills, and ships an interactive tools-init wizard that provisions credentials by writing MCP entries directly into ~/.claude.json. Run /kai migrate if you're coming from the retired mosaic-buddy or mosaic-admin plugins.
